title: Kinetic study of catalytic formic acid dehydrogenation by in situ UV-vis spectroscopy
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01328J, Paper
Seo Ono, Risheng Li, Chieko Suzuki, Akira Yamamoto, Hisao Yoshida, Hajime Kawanami, Ryoichi Kanega
We developed an in situ UV-vis spectroscopy method to study formic acid dehydrogenation kinetics. This method revealed hydride formation and H2 evolution rates, highlighting the need to enhance both steps to improve catalyst activity.
